How can I support you and your family today?
consent_body:
Hello! I'm dayli — a health companion for you and your family, with an eye on the weather where you are.

Before we start: to give you advice that actually fits, I need to remember a little about you — who I am helping, and roughly where you are.

• I keep it private and never sell it
• You can say *opt out* or *stop* at any time and I will delete it
• I'm not a doctor, and I can't diagnose anything

Is that OK?
consent_terms_body:
Here is exactly how dayli handles your data:

• *Storage:* Encrypted, anonymized, and never linked to your identity
• *Sharing:* Zero third-party sharing or advertising
• *Deletion:* Send *STOP* or *OPT OUT* anytime to permanently erase your data (DPDP Act compliant)
• *Scope:* Educational triage, hyperlocal weather, and nearest facility routing only

Ready to proceed?
consent_declined_body:
I understand. Your consent has been respected and no profile data has been stored.

If you ever change your mind or need emergency guidance, simply text *HI* or *START*.

_For urgent medical emergencies, please call 112 immediately._
stop_confirmation:
🛑 *Data Deleted & Opted Out*

You have been unsubscribed and all personal data, session history, and cached locations have been permanently deleted in accordance with the DPDP Act.

To restart anytime, simply text *START* or *HI*.

welcome_body:
Hello {userName}! I'm Dayli AI — your maternal, pediatric, and climate-health assistant.

You can ask me:
1. ☀️ Weather & heatwave warnings for your area
2. 💧 Safe hydration & infant care tips
3. 🏥 Nearest ready labour rooms & pharmacies
4. 🌡️ Fever & pregnancy symptom guidance

How can I help you today?
emergency_lead: What you described can become life-threatening quickly.
emergency_action_112: Call emergency services now — 112 in India — or go straight to the nearest emergency department.
emergency_action_upright: Keep baby upright and supported so the airway stays open. Loosen any tight clothing.
emergency_action_no_fluids: Do not give any food, milk, water or ORS while breathing is difficult — it can be inhaled into the lungs.
emergency_maternal_102: For maternal emergencies, call 102 (Amma Vodi) or 108 immediately for priority ambulance transport.

heat_hydration_infant:
💧 *Infant Hydration & Heat Safety (WHO Clinical Protocol)*

• *Babies under 6 months:* Offer breastmilk or formula only. *STRICTLY NO PLAIN WATER* — plain water can cause dangerous electrolyte dilution and water intoxication.
• Offer frequent nursing feeds during peak afternoon heat.
• Dress baby in one light layer of breathable cotton.
• Watch for red flags: sunken fontanelle (soft spot), dry diapers (>6h), or no tears when crying.
heat_hydration_maternal:
💧 *Maternal & Heatwave Hydration Guidance*

• Drink 2.5–3 liters of safe drinking water throughout the day.
• Avoid direct sun exposure during peak heat (12:00 PM – 4:00 PM).
• Keep tender coconut water, buttermilk, or electrolyte ORSL handy.
• If experiencing heat cramps in legs or dizziness, rest in a cool shaded room immediately.
air_quality_guidance:
🌫️ *Air Quality (AQI) Health Protection*

• Keep pregnant mothers, infants, and elderly family members indoors when AQI is high.
• Wear a snug-fitting N95 mask if outdoor transit is unavoidable.
• Keep windows closed during peak traffic hours (8–11 AM, 6–9 PM).
• Seek immediate medical attention if wheezing, shortness of breath, or chest tightness occurs.
fever_guidance:
🌡️ *Clinical Fever Management*

• *Infants under 3 months:* ANY fever is a medical priority — seek same-day clinical assessment.
• Sponge with lukewarm water only. Never use cold water, ice packs, or alcohol rubs.
• Keep well hydrated with frequent small sips.
⚠️ *I cannot prescribe medication or dosages.* Please consult a doctor or pharmacist for weight-appropriate antipyretics.
_For emergencies or fever with seizure/stiff neck, dial 112/108 immediately._
pregnancy_guidance:
🌸 *Maternal Pregnancy Guidance*

• Pay close attention to hydration and fetal movements (at least 10 kicks in 2 hours after a meal).
• Rest in left lateral position (lying on your left side) to improve blood flow to the placenta.
🚨 *Warning Signs requiring immediate hospital review:*
  - Any vaginal bleeding or leaking of fluid
  - Severe abdominal pain or continuous contractions
  - Severe headache, blurred vision, or sudden facial swelling
  - Reduced fetal movements

Type *HOSPITAL* anytime to find the nearest ready labour room with available beds.
infant_guidance:
👶 *Infant & Pediatric Care Guidance*

• Ensure frequent feeds (breastfeeding every 2–3 hours).
• Burp baby gently upright after feeds to relieve colic and trapped air.
• Keep baby in a well-ventilated, shaded space in light cotton.
🚨 *Red flags:* Grunting breath, blue lips, severe diarrhea (>6 times), sunken soft spot, or extreme lethargy require emergency evaluation.
adult_symptom_guidance:
🩺 *Headache & Adult Symptom Guidance*

Headaches and fatigue are very commonly triggered by heat exposure, dehydration, eye strain, or physical tension.

• *Hydrate immediately:* Drink a large glass of water or electrolyte fluids (ORS, coconut water, or fresh buttermilk).
• *Rest in a quiet, dark room:* Lie down, close your eyes, and place a cool, damp cloth on your forehead or the back of your neck.
• *Screen rest:* Give your eyes a complete break from phones and computer screens.
• *Maternal check:* If pregnant, a severe or persistent headache with blurred vision or sudden facial swelling requires immediate blood pressure monitoring with a doctor.

🚨 *Call 112 if:* the headache comes on suddenly with explosive pain, stiff neck, high fever, or difficulty speaking.
